label: entry session high / open - 1 >= +50% (signal = prior close)

oracle_train.note: One perfect +50% limit-fill per event day, no losses, fresh notion each day (the slot is free after the intraday target). Ignores same-bar path risk.

oracle_test.note: One perfect +50% limit-fill per event day, no losses, fresh notion each day (the slot is free after the intraday target). Ignores same-bar path risk.

oracle_full.note: One perfect +50% limit-fill per event day, no losses, fresh notion each day (the slot is free after the intraday target). Ignores same-bar path risk.

note: Walk-forward accuracy = hoogste train-Wilson op packs met train-PnL>0, ≥3 hits en ≥12 trades. Walk-forward PnL = hoogste train-PnL met ≥12 trades en train-DD≤70%. Best test / best full zijn de maxima van de grid (zoekmaxima, geen schone keuze). Best full met train-PnL>0 is het hoogste full-pad dat in-sample ook geld verdiende.
